verdict.rationale: Atlassian's own pages say Jira can be extended through the Atlassian Marketplace with "over 3000+ integrations" and "over 3,000 other apps," naming examples such as Tempo Timesheets and Zephyr. They also cite connections to Slack, Figma, Gmail, Bitbucket, Trello and Confluence, which directly matches the "thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace" story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience, and in-depth docs on how apps are discovered, installed and administered (current evidence is feature-page marketing claims only).
